stock_name: Flathead sole - Bering Sea / Aleutian Islands
selection_basis: The 2024 BSAI SAFE chapter and pinned Model 18.2c native files provide annual catch and biomass-index observations, fishery and survey length/age compositions, fixed mortality and biological assumptions, and fitted age-specific population and mortality outputs. The source distinguishes combined flathead sole/Bering flounder catches from flathead-sole age samples. Selected as one current BSAI stock-unit assessment; source records will preserve this distinction and will not fabricate observed catch-at-age or an age-specific survey index.
